entries.title: Job 9:1
segments: Then Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 9:2
segments: Of a truth I know that it is so: But how can man be just with God?

entries.title: Job 9:3
segments: If he be pleased to contend with him, He cannot answer him one of a thousand.

entries.title: Job 9:4
segments: [He is] wise in heart, and mighty in strength: Who hath hardened himself against him, and prospered?-

entries.title: Job 9:5
segments: [Him] that removeth the mountains, and they know it not, When he overturneth them in his anger;

entries.title: Job 9:6
segments: That shaketh the earth out of its place, And the pillars thereof tremble;

entries.title: Job 9:7
segments: That commandeth the sun, and it riseth not, And sealeth up the stars;

entries.title: Job 9:8
segments: That alone stretcheth out the heavens, And treadeth upon the waves of the sea;

entries.title: Job 9:9
segments: That maketh the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, And the chambers of the south;

entries.title: Job 9:10
segments: That doeth great things past finding out, Yea, marvellous things without number.

entries.title: Job 9:11
segments: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: He passeth on also, but I perceive him not.

entries.title: Job 9:12
segments: Behold, he seizeth [the prey], who can hinder him? Who will say unto him, What doest thou?

entries.title: Job 9:13
segments: God will not withdraw his anger; The helpers of Rahab do stoop under him.

entries.title: Job 9:14
segments: How much less shall I answer him, And choose out my words [to reason] with him?

entries.title: Job 9:15
segments: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer; I would make supplication to my judge.

entries.title: Job 9:16
segments: If I had called, and he had answered me, Yet would I not believe that he hearkened unto my voice.

entries.title: Job 9:17
segments: For he breaketh me with a tempest, And multiplieth my wounds without cause.

entries.title: Job 9:18
segments: He will not suffer me to take my breath, But filleth me with bitterness.

entries.title: Job 9:19
segments: If [we speak] of strength, lo, [he is] mighty! And if of justice, Who, [saith he], will summon me?

entries.title: Job 9:20
segments: Though I be righteous, mine own mouth shall condemn me: Though I be perfect, it shall prove me perverse.

entries.title: Job 9:21
segments: I am perfect; I regard not myself; I despise my life.

entries.title: Job 9:22
segments: It is all one; therefore I say, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.

entries.title: Job 9:23
segments: If the scourge slay suddenly, He will mock at the trial of the innocent.

entries.title: Job 9:24
segments: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; He covereth the faces of the judges thereof: If [it be] not [he], who then is it?

entries.title: Job 9:25
segments: Now my days are swifter than a post: They flee away, they see no good,

entries.title: Job 9:26
segments: They are passed away as the swift ships; As the eagle that swoopeth on the prey.

entries.title: Job 9:27
segments: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will put off my [sad] countenance, and be of good cheer;

entries.title: Job 9:28
segments: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.

entries.title: Job 9:29
segments: I shall be condemned; Why then do I labor in vain?

entries.title: Job 9:30
segments: If I wash myself with snow water, And make my hands never so clean;

entries.title: Job 9:31
segments: Yet wilt thou plunge me in the ditch, And mine own clothes shall abhor me.

entries.title: Job 9:32
segments: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, That we should come together in judgment.

entries.title: Job 9:33
segments: There is no umpire betwixt us, That might lay his hand upon us both.

entries.title: Job 9:34
segments: Let him take his rod away from me, And let not his terror make me afraid:

entries.title: Job 9:35
segments: Then would I speak, and not fear him; For I am not so in myself.
